summary: Keep Mealie recipes handy in a counter-friendly cooking view.
page_description: A read-only Mealie companion. Pick tonight's recipe and cook one large step at a time, with the screen kept on and the recipe available offline.
release_notes: Clearer description in the Store. No change to how the app works.

steps.text: Make the Mealie API available to the Kobo at https://mealie.local.
Create a long-lived Mealie API token and install it under the exact name mealie.
